subject: Mutual Action Plan: Cygnus Health capacity reservation & evaluation runway
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alyssa Moore <alyssa@cygnushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-03-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: Cygnus Health capacity reservation & evaluation runway

Hi Alyssa,

Thanks for the time today — good alignment on the big picture. I took a first pass at a MAP that focuses on (1) an evaluation runway to validate latency/cost at scale and (2) a capacity reservation approach for Dedicated/Private given current hardware lead times.

Quick summary of the proposal (high level):
- Eval kickoff: 2-week perf baseline on hosted + short-lived Dedicated trial (3–5 nodes) to validate end-to-end latency and cost.
- Typical procurement lead times we are seeing now: H100 ~12–16 weeks, A100 ~8–12 weeks, L4/other ~4–8 weeks depending on region and vendor.
- Suggested starting pool sizing for your projected peak: an initial tranche equivalent to 24 A100-class slots (roughly 6 x A100-80GB or 12 x L4). Scale in a second tranche to reach full target once acceptance gates are met.
- Acceptance gates for tranche 1: 95th percentile latency target <= 100 ms for 512-token profile, quality regression <= 2% on your holdout eval set, and confirmation of SOC2 artifacts for data flow and logging.

Attachments: Cygnus_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP milestones/responsibilities) and eval-runbook-2027.pdf (measurement plan and scripts).

Acceleration options (pick one based on risk appetite):
1) Hybrid bridge — start validation on hosted and burst to a small Dedicated cluster while hardware is in transit (fastest empirical validation).
2) Staged Dedicated — reserve a smaller tranche now (reduces lead time risk) and commit the second tranche after eval acceptance.
3) Private/on-prem — Redwood manages control plane; customer owns procurement. Longest lead time but max isolation.

Proposed milestone draft (tentative):
- Eval kickoff: 2027-03-22
- Eval complete & decision: 2027-04-05
- PO for tranche 1: 2027-04-12
- Delivery tranche 1 (A100 lead time ~8 weeks): ~2027-06-07
- Tranche 1 acceptance: ~2027-06-21

Can you confirm two things so we can finalize the MAP: (a) is SOC2 evidence a gating item before tranche 1 acceptance or only before tranche 2 / full private go-live? (b) do you have a hard constraint on delivery date (e.g., must be live by July)?

If it helps I can propose two concrete paths in a follow-up: a conservative path (Staged Dedicated) and an accelerated path (Hybrid bridge + tranche ordering).

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0118

From: Alyssa Moore <alyssa@cygnushealth.com>

Date: 2027-03-15T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: Cygnus Health capacity reservation & evaluation runway

Jordan — thanks for the clear plan and the MAP doc. A few items from our side: we are aiming for full production in Q3, ideally mid-July. We can be flexible on staging, but SOC2 is non-negotiable for any dedicated/private access to PHI. SOC2 artifacts (control descriptions + evidence) will need to be provided before tranche 2 acceptance; for tranche 1 we can accept limited access under a strict data handling appendix if Redwood can provide the specific logs and retention policies during the eval.

For sizing: our internal product team says "8 effective H100-class GPUs at peak" for the initial launch (this is the user-facing peak concurrency target). If you translate that into an A100-equivalent tranche, we want the initial tranche to comfortably cover a 2x safety factor to avoid early throttling.

Can you confirm the burst-to-hosted approach you mentioned — how quickly can Redwood enable burst capacity (hours/days) and what are the cost implications for that arrangement? Also, we need procurement to see an estimate for a 12-month reserved commitment for tranche 1 vs a month-to-month ramp.

Appreciate the running list — cc'ed procurement for visibility.

Thanks,
Alyssa
VP Product, Cygnus Health
alyssa@cygnushealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>

Date: 2027-03-16T11:37:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: technical notes for Cygnus MAP

Jordan — internal tech notes to include in the MAP (short):
- For the eval, run two profiles: latency-sensitive (512 tokens, 95th P99 targets) and throughput (batch sizes 8–32, end-to-end cost per 1k tokens).
- Suggest quantization path: start with FP16 on A100; if cost is a gating factor, measure 4-bit quantized variant on a subset (quality/regression checks required).
- Cache strategy: enable prefix/KV caching for prompt templates and warm top-k common requests to reduce steady-state token compute.
- Test harness ask: provide a small Dedicated cluster (4 x A100-80GB nodes) with our orchestrator and the customer's model pinned. Capture traces for 72 hours to estimate real-world tail latencies.
- Acceptance checklist: traces uploaded to shared drive, 95th latency threshold met, quality delta <2% on customer eval set, SOC2 SOW signed + evidence bucket granted read access.

I'll draft a short appendix for the MAP listing the above as "technical acceptance criteria" and share with Ben for pricing inputs.

— Marissa
Principal Solutions Architect

> Short note: we can probably offer a "burst credit" construct (prepaid tokens applied to hosted bursts) to make hybrid bridge predictable. Need Ben to confirm discounting mechanics.

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>

Subject: Re: Internal: technical notes for Cygnus MAP — pricing & SOW notes

Jordan / Marissa — pricing and commercial notes (high level):
- Reserved tranche 1 (12-month commit for approx 24 A100-equivalent slots): list price $1,200,000/year. Proposed customer-facing offer: $1,020,000/year (15% tiered discount) if signed within 30 days.
- Month-to-month ramp (no commit): premium usage model — expect ~25–40% higher unit rates.
- Hybrid bridge: charge hosted usage at standard rates, Redwood applies a negotiated burst credit (we can pre-allocate $40k in burst credits that only apply to eval traffic).
- SOC2 compliance package: $25k implementation and evidence ingestion fee (one-time) plus $2k/month for evidence retention & audit logging storage.

Attached SOW stub and a sample committed pricing worksheet (will push to HubSpot): https://app.hubspot.com/deal/987654321

Ben
Director, Enterprise Sales Ops

Subject: Final MAP (v1) & next steps — please review and sign

Alyssa — thanks for the quick turnaround and the procurement visibility. Per our internal sync we've updated the MAP and commercial proposal; highlights below (MAP v1):
- Eval kickoff: 2027-03-22 (hosted + 4-node Dedicated trial).
- Eval completion: 2027-04-05 (deliverables: perf traces, quality report, cost projection).
- Tranche 1 commitment: 24 A100-equivalent slots on a 12-month reserved contract. PO target: 2027-04-12.
- Delivery window: expected 8–12 weeks after PO for A100-class hardware (tentative delivery target early/mid June).
- SOC2: customer will provide SOC2 control descriptions and evidence; Redwood will complete evidence ingestion during eval and SOC2 package must be finalized prior to tranche 2 activation. SOC2 implementation fee outlined in the SOW.
- Commercial: draft committed pricing shown in the attached SOW stub; Ben's team offered a 15% early-signing discount if signed within 30 days of the PO.

Options to reduce time-to-production: we recommend starting the user-facing validation on hosted immediately and enabling burst-to-dedicated for the eval window. This lets your product team validate traffic patterns while hardware ships. Burst credits will be pre-provisioned for the eval so costs are predictable.

Next steps I propose for the MAP (action owners):
- Cygnus: confirm SOC2 gating (Procurement) and provide PO window (Procurement).
- Redwood (Jordan/Marissa/Ben): finalize SOW + technical acceptance criteria; schedule eval engineering kickoff (Marissa).
- Legal: circulate data handling appendix for private access.

If everything looks good, click the DocuSign link to accept this MAP and the attached SOW stub: https://docusign.net/embeddedSigning/abc123

I'll follow up with a calendar invite for the eval kickoff and dev onboarding.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
